text: The National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Plan (NDRRMP) 2020–2030 is a comprehensive framework designed to reduce disaster risk and enhance resilience in the Philippines. It aligns with national laws and international frameworks to integrate disaster risk reduction (DRR) and climate change adaptation (CCA) into national development planning. The plan is structured around four thematic areas: Prevention and Mitigation, Preparedness, Response and Early Recovery, and Rehabilitation and Recovery. It emphasizes inclusivity, human rights, and evidence-based decision-making, with a focus on vulnerable communities and ecosystems.
